title: Wisdom in consultation
literal_meaning: At the gathering of the five is the Supreme Lord.
explanation: The religious image gives weight to people deliberating together. It can encourage consultation rather than a decision made alone; it does not guarantee a group is right.
meaning_odia: ମିଳିମିଶି ବିଚାର କରୁଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ ମତକୁ ଏଠାରେ ବଡ଼ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଏକାକୀ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେବା ବଦଳରେ ଅନ୍ୟଙ୍କ କଥା ଶୁଣିବାର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଏଥିରୁ ବୁଝାଯାଇପାରେ। ତେବେ ଅନେକ ଜଣ କହିଲେ ମାତ୍ର ସେହି କଥା ସବୁବେଳେ ସତ୍ୟ ବା ନ୍ୟାୟସଂଗତ ହୁଏନାହିଁ।
usage_example: Before changing a shared courtyard, neighbours sit together to hear one another’s needs. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary places this under five people gathered to discuss a subject. It is not the differently worded source127 position15.

odia_summary: ମିଳିମିଶି ବିଚାର କରିବାକୁ ଏହି କଥା ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଏ; ଦଳ ଯାହା କହିବ ତାହା ସବୁବେଳେ ଠିକ୍ ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Consultation can improve a decision, without guaranteeing that a group is always right.
